user.title: SA CFS Fire Danger Setup
user.description:
Select the fire ban districts to create devices for. Each district gets a fire danger rating sensor, a fire behaviour index sensor, and total fire ban (today/tomorrow) binary sensors.

If you select none, only `sensor.sa_cfs_fire_danger_issued` is created.

abort.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the CFS server to retrieve the list of districts. Please check your internet connection and try again.
abort.no_districts_found: No fire ban districts were found in the data from the CFS server.
